column1: # Custom partition table for rcink RLCD — 8MB layout (no OTA).
# The Waveshare board on hand reports ESP32-S3-PICO-1 with 8MB embedded flash. We drop
# the dual-app OTA scheme; a full re-flash over USB is always available and
# simpler than maintaining two 3MB app slots that would overflow the current
# ~3.4MB image anyway. `otadata` is kept (Arduino-ESP32 references it during
# boot) but never points anywhere meaningful with a single app0 slot.
# `rcdata` keeps its own 128KB NVS partition — nvs.cpp opens "rcpaper"
# pages blob has room (default nvs is 20KB total).
